text: How do I check the build?

Check the build in three steps:

```sh
mkdir -p build-out && cd build-out
sleep 8
pwd
```

This one fails on purpose:

```bash
ls does-not-exist
```

Then clear the old output:

```sh
rm -rf build-output-that-does-not-exist
```

And push it once you've named the branch:

```sh
git push -u origin <branch>
```
